rows.note: Use this for a person, style, or idea that feels old-fashioned or behind the times, especially in casual speech.

example.english: Your prehistoric way of flirting is why nobody pays attention to you.
example.traditional: 你仲用呢種老土方法追女仔，梗係冇人理你啦。
example.jyutping: nei5 zung6 jung6 ne1 zung2 lou5 tou2 fong1 faat3 zeoi1 neoi5 zai2 gang2 hai6 mou5 jan4 lei5 nei5 laa1

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is that something is ancient or very old rather than merely unfashionable.

example.english: This prehistoric cave still has lots of murals inside.
example.traditional: 呢個古老山洞入面仲有好多壁畫。
example.jyutping: ni1 go3 gu2 lou5 saan1 dung6 jap6 min6 zung6 jau5 hou2 do1 bik1 waa2

rows.note: Use this for the all-purpose meaning relating to the period before written history.

example.english: Archaeologists dug up a stone tool used by prehistoric humans.
example.traditional: 考古學家喺度掘出咗史前人類用過嘅石器。
example.jyutping: haau2 gu2 hok6 gaa1 hai2 dou6 gwat6 ceot1 zo2 si2 cin4 jan4 leoi6 jung6 gwo3 ge3 sek6 hei3
